The console has a vertical black stripe down the center, characteristic of the PS5 Pro model.
The controllers are white with black grips and silver buttons, matching the PS5 Pro design.
No games, cables, or accessories are visible in any photo.
The console appears to be in good physical condition with no visible cracks or damage.
The seller claims '10 games and two pads' but no games are shown in any photo.
